from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Parse the departure date
departure_date_str = "May 22, 2025"
departure_date = datetime.strptime(departure_date_str, "%B %d, %Y").date()

# Calculate check-in and check-out dates
check_in_date = departure_date
check_out_date = departure_date + timedelta(days=5)

# Search for flights from Atlanta to Portland
flights_result = search_flights(
    start_airport_city="Atlanta",
    end_airport_city="Portland",
    departure_date=[departure_date_str],
    arrival_date=[(check_in_date + timedelta(days=1)).strftime("%B %d, %Y")]
)

# Save flights result to cache
save_to_cache(key="flights", value=flights_result)

# Search for hotels in Portland
hotels_result = search_hotels(
    city="Portland",
    checkin_date=[departure_date_str],
    checkout_date=[(check_out_date + timedelta(days=1)).strftime("%B %d, %Y")],
    num_people=5,
    num_rooms=4
)

# Save hotels result to cache
save_to_cache(key="hotels", value=hotels_result)
